module: Cache of "raw" points of interest (POI) per level. It collects POIs by emitting the hook `onGetRawPoiListForLevel(levelIdentifier, elements)` to all extensions, filters the list according to context (career/tutorial, test drive, delivery, discovery tutorials, multiseat) and caches the result with a generation number. A modder who adds POIs implements the hook in their extension and adds their elements to the received table.
usage:
-- in an extension
M.onGetRawPoiListForLevel = function(level, elements)
  table.insert(elements, {id = 'monPoi', data = {type = 'monType', id = 'monPoi'}, clusterType = 'x', markerInfo = {}})
end
notes: A valid element must have `data` with `id` or `missionId`, a `clusterType`, and `markerInfo`; the standard filter loop accesses e.markerInfo.bigmapMarker without checking markerInfo, so an element without markerInfo causes an error.
validateRawPoiElement is defined but never called; it does not set valid to false when clusterType is missing (only the log reports the problem).
With multiseat active, only elements with a markerInfo[type].multiseat == true are kept. A multiseat state change clears the cache.

In career on west_coast_usa: during the tutorial, only the onGetRawPoiListForTutorial hook is used; before the starter vehicle is purchased, only POIs of type dealership, inspectVehicle and computer are returned (not cached).
The bigmapMarker.cluster field is true by default when not defined.

If a type whitelist is active (test drive: testDriveEnd; delivery: deliveryTargetArea, deliveryVehicle; discovery tutorials: tutorialLesson, firstDriveDestination...), only those types (or whitelisted mission ids) are kept.

showMissionMarkersToggled.desc: Alias of clear: the cache is cleared when the mission marker display changes.

onModManagerReady.desc: Alias of clear: the cache is cleared when the mod manager is ready.

clear.desc: Clears the POI cache of all levels and increments the generation number (consumers thus detect that they must reload).

getRawPoiGeneration.desc: Current generation number of the cache (after synchronizing the multiseat state).

getRawPoiListByLevel.desc: Returns the filtered POI list of a level, building it (hook onGetRawPoiListForLevel) if it is not cached.

levelIdentifier.desc: Level identifier; if nil, returns an empty list.
